title: [Bug]: RedisStorage upsert_session key incorrect
body:
```Python
       record = SessionRecord(
            user_id=user_id,
            agent_id=agent_id,
            config=config,
            source=source,
            source_schedule_id=source_schedule_id,
            state=state if state is not None else AgentState(),
        )
        key = self._key(
            self.key_config.session,
            user_id=user_id,
            session_id=record.id,
        )
        index_key = self._key(
            self.key_config.session_index,
            user_id=user_id,
            agent_id=agent_id,
        )
        await self._set_with_ttl(key, record.model_dump_json())
        await self._client.sadd(index_key, record.id)
```
in this code, if first create the session, will create a new SessionRecord in the method, and than save to Redis by the key: record_id (Generated by new uuid, not same with session_id).
But get_session and update_session_state, use key by session_id, is incorrect

```Python
        key = self._key(
            self.key_config.session,
            user_id=user_id,
            session_id=session_id,
        )
        raw = await self._client.get(key)
        if not raw:
            raise KeyError(f"Session {session_id!r} not found.")
```
